title: A user_facts profile bind closes the gap but names a FACT ID, not a value — structurally unassessable (R-A10 AC5)

asks.label: unassessable
asks.why: AC5 says inventory closes this gap, and the binder does bind it (state=have, source=operator_profile). But _bind_profile deliberately returns NO resolved value for a user_facts entry — a fact is a sentence ('account_id is acct-42'), not the parameter value — so no bound_value_digest is stamped and there is nothing for the replay to compare the answer against. Reporting this as 'avoidable' would be an unproven claim and as 'necessary' would be a false accusation, so it is unassessable. This is a real observability limit of the profile-fact bind path, not a fixture defect.
